findings.claim: vaultBackup.BackUp creates the backup directory before copying any file and never removes it when a copy fails part-way. A failed run therefore leaves a partial directory that looks like a complete rollback copy. The directory name has one-second resolution, so a retry within the same second fails on os.Mkdir with 'exists', and a later retry produces a second directory. Nothing marks which one is complete.

evidence: Reviewed the full diff of the three changed paths. BackUp is the only code that writes outside the vault pages, and the partial-backup residue on a mid-copy failure is the only defect I could identify in it.
The report and refusal output logic is consistent with its tests; I found no mismatch between the claimed behavior and the changed lines.
